## Constant-heat-capacity moist mixture (`ideal-moist`) {#sec-ch02-ideal-moist}

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Explicit `type: ideal-moist`; requires thermo; default EOS remains `moist-mixture`.
Condensates carry mass and heat but no pressure share.
The fixed-composition relation is @eq-ch02-ideal-moist-energy; no spatial order applies.
:::

### Derivation

Let $y_n$ be mass fraction per total mass, not mixing ratio per dry mass. The dry density is
$\rho_{\mathrm d}=\rho(1-\sum_n y_n)$ in $\mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$.
Add the partial gas pressures and the heat capacities of all species. Dividing the first sum by
$\rho R_{\mathrm d}T$ and the second by $\rho c_{v,\mathrm d}$ yields

$$
\begin{aligned}
f_\varepsilon&=1+\sum_{n\in\mathcal V}y_n(\mu_{\mathrm d}/\mu_n-1)-\sum_{n\in\mathcal C}y_n,\\
f_\sigma&=1+\sum_n y_n(c_{v,n}/c_{v,\mathrm d}-1).
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch02-ideal-moist-factors}

@eq-ch02-ideal-moist-factors is implemented by `f_eps` in [`ideal_moist.cpp:319-346`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/ideal_moist.cpp#L319-L346).

The reference energies $u_n^\star$ have units $\mathrm{J\,kg^{-1}}$ and enter additively, including dry air.
Using $R_{\mathrm d}=(\gamma_{\mathrm d}-1)c_{v,\mathrm d}$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
\rho e&=\rho_{\mathrm d}u_{\mathrm d}^\star+\sum_n\rho_nu_n^\star
+\rho c_{v,\mathrm d}f_\sigma T,\\
p&=\rho R_{\mathrm d}f_\varepsilon T,\\
p&=\frac{(\gamma_{\mathrm d}-1)f_\varepsilon}{f_\sigma}
\left(\rho e-\rho_{\mathrm d}u_{\mathrm d}^\star-\sum_n\rho_nu_n^\star\right).
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch02-ideal-moist-energy}

@eq-ch02-ideal-moist-energy is implemented by `_cons2prim` in [`ideal_moist.cpp:164-233`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/ideal_moist.cpp#L164-L233).

For frozen composition, $c_p-c_v=R_{\mathrm d}f_\varepsilon$; divide by
$c_v=c_{v,\mathrm d}f_\sigma$ to obtain

$$
\gamma=1+(\gamma_{\mathrm d}-1)f_\varepsilon/f_\sigma
$$ {#eq-ch02-ideal-moist-gamma}

@eq-ch02-ideal-moist-gamma is implemented by `gammad` in [`ideal_moist.cpp:113-128`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/ideal_moist.cpp#L113-L128).

Species thermal energy is $u_n^\star+c_{v,n}T$. A gas adds $R_nT$ to form specific enthalpy;
a condensate does not. The carried energy adds the specific kinetic energy to either result, as derived in
@sec-ch02-consistency. These are exact constant-capacity identities for a uniform cell, without quadrature or
iteration. `ideal-moist_check.py` verifies the factors, energy recovery and frozen-composition heat ratio.

### Numerical method

Both conversion directions use total density for velocity, while the conserved density row stores only dry air.
The pressure calculation subtracts all reference energies after kinetic energy. The inverse adds them.
There is no neighbour stencil; floors bracket the maps. Thermo reference buffers are populated at reset,
so a later process-global species-table change must not alter this EOS.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
Constant heat capacities are assumed even if a thermo card requests temperature-dependent options. The TODO
about iteration in the pressure maps is not a measured defect of this constant-capacity identity.
The offset test uses a dry card; it does not by itself test all species offsets.
Switch-combination coverage remains pending in @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
